bagPolicy.summary: Raymond James Stadium enforces a No Bag policy for all events, allowing only one clutch purse no larger than 4.5” by 6.5”. Bags larger than this size are not permitted, even if clear.
allowed: one clutch purse no larger than 4.5” x 6.5”
prohibited: Aerosol or spray bottles of sunscreen
Any item that could be used as a missile
Cameras longer than 12 inches or with detachable lenses
Unmanned Aircraft Systems & Radio Controlled Model Aircraft/Drones
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking at Raymond James Stadium is cashless and contactless, with prices varying by event. Parking is first-come, first-served, and advance purchase is recommended. RV and camper parking is available in designated lots.

rideshare.note: The rideshare drop-off and pick-up area is located at Steinbrenner Field. For events with higher volumes, check the website for updates.

concessions.note: Raymond James Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, including local specialties and chef-driven creations. Highlights include $6 domestic beer cans, a $20 gameday combo, and the Tampa Chef Series featuring local culinary offerings. The venue emphasizes locally sourced and sustainable ingredients.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Raymond James Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted unless in the event of a medical emergency.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Raymond James Stadium Ticket Office is only open on event days; it does not have normal operating hours. For lost or stolen tickets on event day, visit the Ticket Office located in the South Plaza between Gates C and D.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Raymond James Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
